summary: Frontend-only testing of guided voice/speed settings features. All 8 requested features verified: (1) Segment X/Y indicator with dots PASS, (2) Settings speed options Slow/Normal/Fast PASS, (3) Settings voice profile options Feminine/Masculine/Balanced PASS, (4) Inline preview buttons for speed and voice PASS, (5) Guided overlay per-practice Voice+Speed override controls PASS, (6) Per-practice persistence modes (Session/Remember) PASS, (7) TTS voice mapping correctly resolves profile ids to TTS voices PASS, (8) Narration completion logic verified in code review PASS.

issues: Minor React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <option> - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: resolveGuidedVoiceId() correctly maps profile ids to TTS voices: feminine→shimmer, masculine→onyx, balanced→nova
TTS API call at useGuidedPracticeEngine.js:465 uses resolveGuidedVoiceId(playbackVoiceProfile) - no invalid profile ids sent to backend
Segment indicator shows 'segment X of Y' format with mini progress dots below
Per-practice override controls (Voice/Speed dropdowns) visible in guided overlay
Settings page has all required controls: Speed (Slow/Normal/Fast), Voice (Feminine/Masculine/Balanced), Override Mode (Session/Remember)
Inline preview buttons exist for both speed options and voice profile options in settings
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 requested features verified working. Settings page at /settings shows guided audio controls. Guided overlay opens from practice cards and shows Voice/Speed override dropdowns. Segment indicator with dots appears during TTS playback.

segment_indicator_with_dots.details: Guided overlay shows 'Guided narration playing • segment 1 of 6' text with mini progress dots below. Dots show active/complete/pending states.

settings_speed_options.details: Settings page shows Guided Voice Speed section with Slow/Normal/Fast options in dropdown. Each option has description text.

settings_voice_profile_options.details: Settings page shows Guided Voice Type section with Feminine (Soft)/Masculine (Grounded)/Balanced (Neutral) options in dropdown.

inline_preview_buttons_speed.details: Settings page shows 'Preview Slow', 'Preview Normal', 'Preview Fast' buttons below speed dropdown.

inline_preview_buttons_voice.details: Settings page shows 'Preview Feminine (Soft)', 'Preview Masculine (Grounded)', 'Preview Balanced (Neutral)' buttons below voice dropdown.

guided_overlay_voice_speed_override.details: Guided overlay shows Voice and Speed dropdowns with data-testid='guided-practice-voice-override-select' and 'guided-practice-speed-override-select'.

per_practice_persistence_modes.details: Settings page shows Per-Practice Override Mode section with 'Session only' and 'Remember per practice' options.

tts_voice_mapping.details: resolveGuidedVoiceId() at guidedVoiceSettings.js:211-227 correctly maps profile ids (feminine/masculine/balanced) to TTS voice names (shimmer/onyx/nova). TTS API call uses this function.

narration_completion_behavior.details: useGuidedPracticeEngine.js:540-548 shows completion only triggers when !narrationSegments[nextIndex] (no more segments). Timer reaching 0 also checks segment completion before marking complete.
